message:
fix(host): re-check the captured monitor's live rect right before each secure-input event; refuse when unknown

Review conditions on dbb7fc0 (P9): the restart-time and once-a-second syncs still leave a
window -- an origin-only display change right after a tick reaches the first UAC click
before the next tick -- and a failed monitor query silently kept the previous rect.

- secure_target_rect_ready() (control thread, host_secure_target_rect.hpp decision): reads
  GetMonitorInfo on the HMONITOR the capture opened (mirrored in
  CaptureState::captureMonitorHandle), updates the broker under its own mutex if the rect
  moved (logged, counted), and refuses the event when the monitor is not readable or the
  rect is empty -- no previous rect, no zero rect that would make the agent aim at the whole
  virtual screen. Wired into both the event and the text secure paths.
- sync_input_target_rect() no longer keeps the old rect on a failed query: it clears the
  broker's rect and logs, so nothing is injected until the monitor is known again.
- Test: host_input_target_rect_test [2c] -- origin moved since the last sync and the click
  arrives before the next tick -> updated before the click; query failed / empty rect ->
  refused; window mode -> refused; no rect yet -> updated. The socket-bound dispatch path
  itself is exercised by the wiring, not by a unit test.
